title: A Written Story Template for Independent Publishing
excerpt: A clean long-form template demonstrates headings, quotations, ordered steps, source links, author context, and topic labels without relying on a document attachment.
body:
## Start with the reader

A written story should explain the central issue quickly, establish what is known, and give readers enough context to understand why the subject matters. The template keeps the reading column focused while the publication chrome stays out of the way.

> Strong publishing separates verified facts, source material, analysis, and opinion so readers can understand what they are seeing.

## Build the article in a clear sequence

1. State the central finding or event.
2. Explain the relevant history and context.
3. Link to supporting material where readers can verify the work.

## Keep the source record portable

The story is stored as a readable JSON record and rendered into static HTML. Editors can revise it through a browser-based CMS while Git preserves every change.

story_blocks.heading: What the Editorial Studio adds
items: A browser-only Quick Story composer that never sends draft text to a server.
Structured newspaper blocks that editors can add and reorder in Pages CMS.
Accessible captions, credits, galleries, timelines, and document cards.
Strict publication checks that keep drafts flexible and published work complete.

story_blocks.quote: Make it easy. Make it fast. Make it accessible.

story_blocks.heading: No database and no extra publishing account
story_blocks.body: The finished site remains static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, and documents. Pages CMS edits the repository through GitHub, while Cloudflare Pages serves the generated publication.

story_blocks.heading: Accessibility is a publication requirement, not an optional polish pass
story_blocks.body: Meaningful images need useful descriptions. Decorative images must be marked decorative. PDFs need direct links and clear HTML context. The build rejects missing reader essentials before a public release.
